characters.name: Jackson "Jax" Teller
characters.description: The President (former Vice President)until his deathof the Sons of Anarchy mother charter, having taken that rank from the previous president, Clay Morrow, by force. Born in 1978 to John and Gemma Teller, he has lived his whole life in Charming and has been raised in the club. While committed to his one-percenter club's lifestyle and his fellow outlaw biker brothers, Jax still yearns to steer the organization onto a path toward long-term stability. His day job is a mechanic at Teller-Morrow Automotive Repair. Affably Evil: Back in the early seasons, Jax was very caring of others and was more moral than the rest of SAMCRO. However, this is twisted in later seasons with his love for his families fueling his violence and manipulation. Alas, Poor Villain:Despite clearly having become irredeemable, his death, committing suicide and dying in the same way as his father, is more than a little saddening All Girls Want Bad Boys: Being aBadass Biker, he sure gets to be with alot of women both before and during the series. Anti-Hero: Straddles the line between Type IV and V. By the end of Season 5, it could be said that he's firmly Type V if not aVillain Protagonist. Season 7 all but confirms it.

characters.name: Clarence "Clay" Morrow
characters.description: The President of SAMCRO and one of the 9 founding members, Clay is Jax Teller's stepfather and Gemma Teller's husband. Suffering from arthritis in his declining age, Clay frequently disagrees with his stepson about the direction the club is going. Affably Evil: Mostly in Season 1. He might be a scheming murderer, but Clay does have a sense of honor, morality and even feels genuine guilt for the terrible things he's done. Personality-wise, he's an easy blend of casual charm and subdued menace. However, he slowly transitions from this toFaux Affably Evil. Alas, Poor Villain: Clay's death may have been a long-time coming, but it's a solemn affair. Only Jax and Tara seem to relish his death; Juice is sent spiraling into depression from his involvement in the events leading up to Clay’s imprisonment and death, Gemma is distraught although understanding, and even Nero is somewhat phased by it. Clay himself faces the decision bravely, makes final peace with Gemma and Juice, and selflessly allows himself to be killed to save the club. All Men Are Perverts: Clay talks a lot about sexual things. Most prominent in Season 6 where he stood up in front of everyone, talking aboutneeding pussy.Ironically, Clay is surprisingly conservative when it comes to pornography and wants nothing to do with the business. He only relents getting into it when he is outvoted, and as soon as it becomes troublesome he wanted to pull the plug. He only relents getting into it when he is outvoted, and as soon as it becomes troublesome he wanted to pull the plug.

characters.name: Gemma Teller Morrow (née Madock)
characters.description: The queen of Charming under Clay's rule. A Machiavellian schemer and expert in psychological manipulation, Gemma is the wife of Clay Morrow and the widow of John Teller. Gemma is extremely protective of her son Jax and grandsons Abel and Thomas and longs for the day when Jax will, in her eyes, be ready to assume control of SAMCRO in order to ensure the organization's survival for another generation. She adores her husband, Clay, and does her best to make things work out his way. Alas, Poor Villain:When Jax finds her, knowing the truth about Tara's murder, she doesn't bother trying to talk her way out of what's coming to her. She takes a last walk in her father's garden, tells Jax that she loves him, and allows him to kill her. Big Bad Ensemble:In Season 7, while Henry Lin, August Marks, and Charles Barosky are all standing in Jax's way, it is Jax's internal conflict that is the biggest struggle, arguably instigated by her. Boom, Headshot!:Courtesy of her own son. After everything she did, it was more than deserved. Control Freak: If Gemma isn't in control, she isn't happy.

characters.name: Dr. Tara Grace Knowles
characters.description: The childhood sweetheart of Jax Teller, Tara left Charming to escape the criminal lifestyle and became a successful surgeon. However, she ends up returning to the town and falling deeper in than ever before. She eventually marries Jax Teller, and tries to get him and their children out of Charming. Every time it seems like she'll finally get them out, something else pops up to keep it from happening. All Girls Want Bad Boys: Largelydeconstructed. Tara was Jax's sweetheart, and eventually marries him, but Jax's lifestyle gradually destroys and corrupts the good person she once was. Berserk Button: In the earlier seasons. Whenever Tara faced the possibility of losing Jax, she starts screaming and breaking everything around her. Beware the Nice Ones: Few could really expect the sweet and scared doctor in season one would transform into a tiny Gemma, complete with the hair. Brainy Brunette: Under that fine dark hair is the brain of an intelligent woman and a very skilled doctor.

characters.name: Alex "Tig" Trager
characters.description: A member of SAMCRO, a veteran of the U.S. Marine Corps and was previously Sergeant-at-Arms under Clay's presidency. While he is one of the club's more violent members and one of the designated hitmen, discussion of Tig's penchant for bizarre and disturbing activities is often played for comic effect. While initially very loyal to Clay, Tig's loyalties have shifted toward the greater club's interests, and he has apparently acclimated himself to Jax's new role as leader after initially questioning his ferocity. Animal Motifs: Dogs. His role in the club is basically being their attack dog. He is also extremely loyal, first with Clay, then later with Jax. Tigg also has an affinity for dogs, being the first to call out the cruelty of a dog-fighting ring. Badass Biker: Minimum requirement to be Sergeant-at-Arms. Bantering Baddie Buddies: Has this dynamic with everyone in the club. Blood Knight: Tig is always eager to fight and loves the route that leads into the thick of battle.

characters.name: Filip "Chibs" Telford
characters.description: SAMCRO's resident Scotsman, Chibs is extremely loyal to Jax. Originally from Glasgow, Scotland, he grew up in Belfast, Northern Ireland. He served as a medic with the British Army, but only lasted five months before he was expelled after a court martial. His military experience makes him the club's medic for backroom emergency surgery. The word "chib" is Scottish street slang for a blade, a slash or a cut. Arch-Enemy: He has a bitter and mutual hatred for Jimmy O'Phelan. He can barely stand to be in the same room with him, since Jimmy stole his family, gave him his scars and exiled him from his home.He finally claims vengeance on Jimmy in the Season 3 finale, giving him a pair of matching facial cuts and then stabbing him to death. Badass Biker: As expected of an SOA member. The Consigliere: By Season 6 he's the new Vice President of SAMCRO. He's much more proactive about it than Bobby was, up to the point of physically putting his hands on Jax and throwing him against the wall when Jax made a particularly stupid move without consulting him first. Cool Shades: Wears them most of the time.

characters.name: Bobby "Elvis" Munson
characters.description: The even-tempered treasury secretary of SAMCRO, and remains in the position after Clay is voted out. The son of a Jewish accountant who worked with the Mafia, Munson brings a level of practicality to the group, offering advice to the younger Jax on a frequent basis. Munson is also known as "Bobby Elvis" for his infrequent dressing up as an Elvis Presley impersonator at toy rallies and other events where children are present. Though he frequently maintains calm among the group, Bobby is more than capable of doing violence. Affably Evil: While being involved in the crime of SAMCRO, he's really kind, humorous and open. Badass Biker: More than capable of hold his own in a fight. Boom, Headshot!:Courtesy of August Marks. The Consigliere: To Clay and later to Jax in Season 5.Returns to it in mid-Season 6, with Jax even referring to him as such.

characters.name: Wayne Unser
characters.description: The former Chief of the Charming Police Department, he is corrupt in that he deals with the Sons of Anarchy whom he sees as a benefit to the town, because the Sons successfully keep drugs and violence out of Charming, and protect the population from many other unwanted things like ruthless developers, such as Jacob Hale Jr. Convenient Terminal Illness: He's been dying of cancer for years now. Corrupt Cop: He has been covering for the Sons for decades and is almost a honorary member of the club. Unlike most examples of this trope, though, he still has a strong moral compass and assists the Sons not out of greed, but because he honestly believes that the police working with the Sons is what's best for Charming. Deal with the Devil: With Jacob Hale in season 3. Despair Event Horizon: Between the end of Season 3 and the beginning of Season 4 when he loses his job.Gemma and Clay drag him back from it.

characters.name: Harry "Opie" Winston
characters.description: The club'sDemolitions Expert, the son of SAMCRO co-founder Piney, and best friend of Jax since childhood. Opie's mother took him away from Piney and Charming when he was 16, but he left her and returned to his father and the club. Affably Evil: He's the best friend a man could ever have, and was torn between SAMCRO and his family. Badass Biker: Obviously. Beard of Sorrow: He was never clean shaven, but he really started growing it out after his wife died. Death Seeker: Becomes this after Donna's death. He gets better eventually, but his father's death at Clay's hands, and being stopped from killing him by Jax himself gets him back to this territory, leading to... (see just below)

characters.name: Piermont "Piney" Winston
characters.description: A co-founder of SAMCRO and father of Opie Winston. He was a veteran of the Vietnam War and must carry an oxygen tank with him at all times due to emphysema. Addiction Displacement: Oh yes, Piney drinks like a fish, but being on oxygen for emphysema prevents him from consuming tobacco (despite hanging out with guys that smoke like chimneys). Thus, he’s seen smelling a cigarette with a look of longing on his face quite often. The Alcoholic: Is seen with a drink more often than not. Gemma at one point calls him out for getting started at 9 in the morning. Badass Biker: Pine runs the old fashion biker style, opting for Ozzy-style sunglasses and a denim kutte; justified as he came up in the life during the Vietnam War. Beware the Quiet Ones/Beware the Nice Ones: He usually doesn't say anything, but he is never afraid to speak his mind when it's extremely important, and messing with his his son's loved ones will literally get you killed.

characters.name: Juan-Carlos "Juice" Ortiz
characters.description: The club's hacker and intelligence officer. He has proven to be somewhat simple-minded when it comes to other tasks, which often prompts hazing from the other members. He is in charge of club surveillance and manages some of the club's intelligence and communication. Clay considers him unreliable, and he is often given menial tasks, such as driving the transport truck. He sports a short Mohawk and has tribal designs tattooed on each side of his head. All for Nothing: Juice's fate in season 7. Despite enduring so much suffering and commiting murder to earn his way back into the club, he ultimately meets the fate he had spent 3 seasons trying to avoid: Excommunicated from the club, assassinated and unmourned by the very people he had considered his family. Badass Adorable: He has his moments. Break the Cutie: More like completely shattered. Juice started off the series as the most naive, soft-hearted member of SAMCRO. Then after Season 4, when he was blackmailed into acting asThe Moleby Potter, it started off hisTrauma Conga Linethat continues for the rest of the series. After 4 seasons of constant manipulation, betrayal, and abuse inflicted on him, he was left as a depressed, broken shell of the man he used to be.

characters.name: Kip "Half-Sack" Epps
characters.description: An Army veteran of the Iraq War and prospective member. Badass Biker: Despite being a prospect with aButt-Monkeystatus, his competence and motorcycle riding skills make up for it. Boxing Battler: He was a junior lightweight boxing champion during his time in the Army. These skills come in handy in "Old Bones" when the club enters him into a bare-knuckle boxing competition for a chance at the winnings. Bullet Dance: Subjected to this as a joke in the Season 2 premiere when the Sons are testing the new KG-9 machine pistols at their new warehouse. Butt-Monkey: Being a prospect means it's his job to be belittled by the club and given all the horrible jobs nobody else wants to do. He's caught in a cycle where the club makes fun of him for being stupid, so he does somethingreallystupid to try and impress them, and thus they mock him even more.

characters.name: Nero Padilla
characters.description: A Mexican-American pimp (who refers to himself as a "companionator") and the head of a gang of Mexicans known as the Byz Lats. Affably Evil: Very much so. Nero is a pimp and a killer, but he's an extremely charming pimp and killer who is genuine in his good intentions and wants to leave the criminal life. Earn Your Happy Ending:Ends up leaving Charming with Wendy, making them the only two major characters that are able to do so. Foil: For Clay. He steps in and more or less fills his primary roles by becoming a mentor and alternative father figure to Jax and Gemma's lover. His more gentle ways and desire to step away from the criminal lifestyle directly contrast Clay. It is also worth noting that he slips back into his old gangster ways almost at exactly the same time that Clay is booted out of the club. Honor Before Reason: His loyalty to SAMCRO, especially Jax and Gemma, is the reason he never truly gives up his life of crime.

characters.name: Happy Lowman
characters.description: SAMCRO's Sergeant-at-Arms. Formerly part of the Tacoma and Nomad charters, Happy is a ruthless killer and sports a happy face tattoo for each one of his assassinations. Like Tig, he is often asked to take on jobs for which no one else has the stomach. Affably Evil: Despite being a coldblooded sociopath, Happy is very likable and friendly. Ambiguously Brown: Just what raceisHappy? There was a reference to "his people" once, and they apparently live on a reserve, but he's never been officially identified as Native American. Whatever he is, he clearly isn't Caucasian. Ascended Extra: Shows up long before his official introduction as the hitman who kills Alvarez's son. Ax-Crazy: He just loves violence, he doesn't care about collateral.

characters.name: George "Ratboy" Skogstrom
characters.description: A young, competent and quiet prospect who is eventually patched in. Ascended Prospect: Rat was a prospect for many seasons before finally being patched in. Butt-Monkey: Like most Prospects, he's given all the dirty jobs that nobody else wants to do. Deadpan Snarker: Since graduating to full member, Rat is a little snarkier. He kinda has to be, givenhis relationship with Tig. Lean and Mean: He's one of the thinner SAMCRO members.

characters.name: Wendy Case
characters.description: Jax Teller's ex-wife and the biological mother of Abel Teller. Wendy intentionally became pregnant in hopes that it would keep Jax with her. She is a drug addict who used methamphetamine during her pregnancy, which nearly killed Abel, who was born 10 weeks premature with a hereditary heart malfunction and a hole in his stomach. Amicable Exes: It's a LONG road to get there but they are firmly this by Season 7. Butt-Monkey: Her life is a series of tragic mistakes. While she has cleaned her life together very well and found a good place for herself, living healthy and sober, the club members forever insist that she is the same reckless junkie she once was. The Bus Came Back: In Season 4, clean and sober, and a lesbian. Though it's not until Season 5 that she really comes back to stay. Driven to Suicide: Wendy very nearly succeeds in killing herself with an overdose, but her doctors manage to save her.

characters.name: Rane Quinn
characters.description: The former President of the Nomad Charter and member of the Indian Hills of the Sons of Anarchy Motorcycle Club and current member of the Redwood Originals. All Bikers Are Hells Angels: He's played by Rusty Coones, President of the Orange County Hell's Angels. Ascended Extra: WasThe Ghostfor the first four seasons, appeared in one episode in Season 5, and has appeared in all but two episodes of Season 6. Is this in universe as well, since he went from being a member of the Indian Hills charter to being in SAMCRO, the original charter. The Big Guy: Towers over everyone else, with arms like tree trunks. Demoted to Extra: In universe example: He went from being the president of the Nomads charter to being a low ranking member in Indian Hills, a chapter that's only been around for two years and was started via patch over.

characters.name: Alesandro Montez
characters.description: A former member of the Sons of Anarchy Motorcycle Club's Reno, NV chapter. Bobby Munson recently recruited him for SAMCRO. Pint-Sized Powerhouse: The shortest of the Sons, but no slouch when it comes time to deliver an ass-whoopin'.

characters.name: Lenny "the Pimp" Janowitz
characters.description: An imprisoned member of the club, convicted of murdering three ATF agents. He is a member of the First 9. His connections with the Russian mob help the club get in contact with Victor Putlova to discuss a deal to have the Russians hand over Jimmy O. to the Sons. He is currently the last member of the First 9 to still be alive. All Bikers Are Hells Angels: Played bySonny Barger, founding member and real life first President of the Oakland Hells Angels. Catchphrase: Not a personal one, but he came up with the term "crow eater" in reference to SAMCRO groupies. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: Despite him being short and seemingly weak, he "allegedly" murdered 3 ATF agents. Justified in that he was apparently a bodybuilder in his youth, as seen below. I Used To Be Quite A Looker: In his younger days Lenny was quite a hunk, gathering croweaters around (he invented the term, in fact) and turning his good looks and charisma into powerful tools to run a prostitution ring.

characters.name: Orlin West
characters.description: A former member of the Sons of Anarchy Motorcycle Club's Reno, NV chapter. Bobby Munson recently recruited him for SAMCRO. Killed Offscreen:By the Lin Triad. We Hardly Knew Ye: One of the more recent recruits, barely speaks, andthe first SAMCRO member to die in the seventh season.

characters.name: "Big" Otto Delaney
characters.description: The husband of Luann Delaney and an imprisoned club member. Ascended Extra: Went from a cameo appearance to being one of the more capable members of the club despite being in prison. Badass Biker: Though we never get to see the "biker" part due to his imprisonment. Badass Boast:"The Sons live. Redwood bleeds." Beware the Quiet Ones: Otto doesn't always say anything unless it's important. He prefers to let his actions do the talking.

characters.name: "Filthy" Phil Russell
characters.description: Originally a prospective member, he is patched in between Seasons 4 and 5. Ascended Fanboy: After the death of Half-Sack. Boom, Headshot!: Courtesy of Galen. Butt-Monkey: Even after being patched in, he tends to get stuck with babysitting jobs when not being framed by Juice. And now he's dead, and even his body isn't left in peace. Galen mutilates him. Gentle Giant: He's by far the biggest member of SAMCRO (bigger than Piney actually) and arguably the nicest.

characters.name: Herman Kozik
characters.description: A member of the Tacoma chapter who moves to Charming. He has a history with Tig. Badass Biker: Throwing down with Tig to a standstill certainly qualifies. Also emphasized in "Dorylus" when he successfully helps thwart a plot to steal SAMCRO's guns. Deadpan Snarker: He dished out as much snark as he took from Tig, even getting sassy with other Sons. Dropped a Bridge on Him: Gets blown to bits by a land mine. We never discover the full story between him and Tig, there's very little resolution to his character and since his death he's rarely mentioned. Sitcom Arch-Nemesis: Again, with Tig. Tig made it his personal mission to veto any vote to bring Kozik in as a member of SAMCRO. Eventually the feud died down and they were civil again, but Tig still can't bring himself to agree to vote him in (but had no problem with it being done while he was incarcerated).

characters.name: John Thomas "JT" Teller
characters.description: THE founding member of the Sons of Anarchy Motorcycle Club, John Teller is long dead at the beginning of the series. Having died under seemingly normal circumstances for an outlaw biker, his death and legacy rear their head at the beginning of the series when his son Jackson finds a manuscript left by him in the family storage unit… Anarchy Is Chaos: Averted, as John appears to have been and organized the original club along optimistic anarchist lines, evidenced by his deep love for the Emma Goldman quote. Out of all the show's cast he appears to be the only actual anarchist (or rather a libertarian, at least according to the principles of the philosophy) rather than a mere outlaw. Death Seeker: He realized very quickly that Gemma and Clay were planning to kill him, but didn't bother to defend himself. He just let it happen. Expy: Of Hamlet's Father with the journal playing the role of his ghost. Knight in Sour Armour: According to Gemma, he became this after Thomas died and he watched the club transform into something much darker than his original vision.

characters.name: Chris 'V-Lin' Von Leen
characters.description: Ascended Fanboy: To Prospect, after Half-Sack's death. Boom, Headshot!: Courtesy of Galen. Passed-Over Promotion: Still a Prospect. Out of Focus: Only barely more than a background character.

characters.name: Shepard
characters.description: Dirty Coward: Does nothing to stop Hector Salazar from vandalizing Lumpy's as well as beating up Lumpy, despite having a gun which would at least give him a fighting chance. Screw This, I'm Outta Here: Leaves behind his cut and his pistol and hightails it out of dodge after failing his first serious test.

characters.name: Frankie Diamonds
characters.description: A New York Nomad who comes to Charming and is voted into the club when the Nomad charter closes. All Bikers Are Hells Angels: Zito, like Sonny Barger, DavidLaBravaand Rusty Coones, is a member of the Hell's Angels in real life. Badass Biker: Subverted;you wouldn't think so with him being played by a real life Hells Angel, but Frankie eventually reveals himself to be nothing more than a greedy murderous coward. Boom, Headshot!:courtesy of Leo Pirelli The Dragon: He's secretly working with Clay to depose Jax, but Frankie is eventually discovered and turns against his former boss.It doesn't save him.

characters.name: GoGo
characters.description: A Nomad who comes to Charming and is voted into the club when the Nomad charter closes. The Brute: To Frankie'sThe Dragon.

characters.name: Greg the Peg
characters.description: A Nomad who is missing a leg. Beard of Evil: He has one. Boom, Headshot!: Clay kills him with a shot to the head. Token Good Teammate: He's the only Nomad who doesn't want to kill Wayne Unser, while Frankie andGoGoare eager.

characters.name: Eric Miles
characters.description: A prospect introduced in Season 3 that gets patched into the club while the majority of the club is in prison. Ascended Fanboy: Mentioned by Opie at the beginning of season 3 to be a hang-around. By the season 4 premiere he has a full patch. Boom, Headshot!:Courtesy of Juice. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: Comes off as a bit of a goof but definitely more competent than some of the other prospects in Season 3. Come Season 4,he holds his own against Juice after discovering him stealing cocaine from the Sons' warehouse, and almost overpowers him. If only he hadn't dropped his gun...

characters.name: Kyle Hobart
characters.description: A member who was excommunicated from the club after abandoning Opie during an arson job, leading to Opie's five-year incarceration. Asshole Victim: A seemingly non-fatal example. Dirty Coward: He abandoned Opie during an arson job, avoiding the police but leaving Opie to face a five-year imprisonment that took a massive toll on him. Jerkass: Kyle is a basic asshole, showing token remorse for abandoning Opie and is even willing to miss his son's band performance to make a half-baked deal with SAMCRO. Tattooed Crook: He had the club colors on his back, similar to Jax and Opie. Unbeknownst to the club, Kyle never had his removed or blacked out after being excommunicated and accidentally reveals it while back in Charming. This leads to the iconic scene where it's burned off via blowtorch and tequila.

characters.name: Seamus Ryan
characters.description: The VP of SAMBEL. Becomes President of SAMBEL after McGee is killed. Combat Medic: He has medical experience, which he uses to aid SAMBEL. Number Two: To Keith McGee, although McGee used O'Neill as a right-hand man. You Are in Command Now: He becomes the Chapter President following the death of McGee.

characters.name: Luther Barkwill
characters.description: The Vice President of Sons of Anarchy Motorcycle Club's the Belfast chapter (SAMBEL). He is also the MC's resident mechanic. Oh, Crap!: When Gemma forces him to drive through a police blockade. You Are in Command Now: Following the deaths of McGee and O'Neill, he's made Vice President of SAMBEL under Ryan.

characters.name: Padraic Telford
characters.description: Sacrificial Lamb: The first named character to die during the trip to Ireland. His death at Jimmy O'Phelan's handsmakes things personalfor his uncle Chibs. We Hardly Knew Ye: Shortly after he's introduced, he's blown to bits by a bomb set by Jimmy O'Phelan.

characters.name: Maureen Ashby
characters.description: The wife, later widow, of Keith McGee. She has ties to the SOA through her late husband and ties to the True IRA through her older brother, Father Kellan Ashby. Beware the Nice Ones: Maureen is polite and considerate of others, but when Cherry admits to lying about Liam's whereabouts, shegrabs her by the throatand delivers a harsh warning about never betraying the Club. Mama Bear: For her daughter Trinity but also, oddly enough, for Jax presumably out of leftover loyalty to John Teller. Secret Other Family: Maureen and Trinity were this to John Teller, although only Maureen knew. Secret Relationship: She had one with John Teller. It's implied that John loved and trusted Maureen more than even Gemma, continuing to write letters to her right up until his death.

characters.name: Trinity Ashby
characters.description: Maureen Ashby's adult daughter and McGee's stepdaughter. Her mother Maureen states that she was 18 when she gave birth to Trinity. She is unaware that John Teller, the founder of the Sons of Anarchy, was her real father. Betty and Veronica: Trinity was the Veronica to Tara's Betty over Jax's Archie. Up until their familial reveal. Brother–Sister Incest: Averted with Trinity and her half-brother Jax as they almost had sex but their mothers stopped them. Fiery Redhead: "Damn it, Ma, I'm not a child!" Secret Other Family: She's John Teller's secret daughter, a fact that even she doesn't know.

characters.name: Rita/Cherry
characters.description: A girl from Indian Hills, Nevada, whose real name is Rita Zambell. After leaving her abusive husband and burning down their condo, she aligns herself with the Devil's Tribe (a friendly independent motorcycle club now patched over to the Sons of Anarchy) and calls herself "Cherry" (after her beloved dead dog), posing as a "hangaround." She takes an interest in Half-Sack when SAMCRO comes to visit, but sleeps with Clay, who wants to punish Half-Sack for voicing his sexual attraction to Gemma. Domestic Abuse: It's inferred her marriage involved violent abuse, due to her referring to her husband as 'sadistic'. Put on a Bus: When Stahl threatens her with prison time, the club sends Cherry off to Northern Ireland to avoid Stahl's clutches. She becomes an employee of Maureen Ashby and old lady to Liam O'Neil.The Bus Came Back: During the Season 3 Ireland arc, she makes a small cameo appearance. The Bus Came Back: During the Season 3 Ireland arc, she makes a small cameo appearance. Woman Scorned: Her 'sadistic' ex wouldn't grant her a divorce, so Cherry stole his car, his money and their dog. She also burned their condo down, and it's implied he was inside it at the time.

characters.name: Fiona Larkin
characters.description: Chibs' estranged wife. Informed Ability: Gemma mentions how Fiona is one of the only three women she's afraid of. However, she doesn't seem to be particularly badass when compared to the other female characters on the show. She's mostly...stoic. Except for that point where she kicked Gemma's ass when she pulled a gun on Jimmy O. Jerkass: To just about everyone. She's closed-off, stoic and rude. Working with the Ex: Working alongside Chibs to take down Jimmy.

characters.name: Kerrianne Telford
characters.description: The teenage daughter of Chibs Telford and Fiona Larkin, raised by Fiona and Jimmy O'Phelan. Ambiguously Brown: She has a black mother and white father. Morality Pet: For Chibs and Fiona. Wife Husbandry: Might've been on the receiving end, unless Jimmy was bluffing.

characters.name: Keith McGee
characters.description: A founding member now based in Northern Ireland and husband of Maureen Ashby. President of SAMBEL, the SoA chapter in Belfast. Alas, Poor Villain: His death is treated as an unfortunate necessity by the Club and Clay. Badass Biker: Being the President of SAMBEL requires this. Bald of Evil: He's an outlaw biker, but he's also working against SAMCRO for money. Disney Villain Death: Clay kills him by pushing him off a building.

characters.name: Liam O'Neill
characters.description: The Sgt.-at-Arms of SAMBEL, also involved with Jimmy O'Phelan. Asshole Victim: Nobody, not even Cherry, felt sorry for his death, acknowledged as a liar and a rat. Cold-Blooded Torture: He takes it at the hands of Sean Casey. The Dragon: As Sergeant-at-Arms, he's this to Keith McGee. Fighting Irish: He participates in bare-knuckle boxing.

characters.name: Les Packer
characters.description: President of the San Bernardino chapter (SAMDINO) of the Sons of Anarchy Motorcycle Club. Badass Biker: Packer is yet to do anything badass on-screen, but his presence and authority certainly signal his badassery. Being played byRobert Patrickcertainly doesn't hurt either. Cool Old Guy: Packer is in his elder years but he's the president of a motorcycle club, and he seems to be extremely competent at it too. Cool Shades: As per usual for a biker. Icy Blue Eyes: As perRobert Patrick.

characters.name: Yates
characters.description: Another member the San Bernadino chapter.

characters.name: Jury (Indian Hills)
characters.description: President of the Indian Hills chapter, which was formerly a friendly but independent MC called the Devil's Tribe MC. Ascended Extra: Made a few minor appearances in past seasons but plays an important supporting role and gets some characterization in season 7. Boom, Headshot!: His death. Cool Old Guy: One of the coolest. Genre Blind: Giving Jax the idea that his son was expendable was not the best course of action, especially after Jax all but said that he was emotionally unhinged. SeeToo Dumb to Live.

characters.name: Armando (SAMTAZ)
characters.description: The President of SAMTAZ, the Tucson, Arizona chapter. Affably Evil: Is personable and level-headed, and works to keep his club together; however his said method of doing so is distributing methamphetamine. He also taunts Clay by racing him in front of their chapters after noticing the latter’s arthritis acting up. The Leader: Of SAMTAZ. Off with His Head!: He is decapitated by the Lobo Sonora Cartel as a message to the Sons for entering business with the Galindo Cartel.

characters.name: Huff (SAMTAZ)
characters.description: Groin Attack: Gets one from Clay when he tries to attack Reggie for revealing his crimes against the club. No-Holds-Barred Beatdown: On the receiving end of one after his and Benny's betrayal comes to light. Obvious Judas: Unlike Benny, Huff is pretty much a dick from the moment he's on screen. It doesn't really come as much surprise when it's revealed he killed a fellow club member and blackmailed another out.

characters.name: Benny (SAMTAZ)
characters.description: Drugs Are Bad: Ends up being a shining example despite it not being clear if he personally used any. Starting a meth cook behind his club's back leads to killing a member who finds out and blackmailing another out of the club. It ends with him and his co-conspirator Huff being excommunicated from the club and getting a vicious beatdown. False Friend: Appears to mourn Little Paul's death and laments Reggie leaving the club not long afterwards. Turns out he's the one responsible for both events. Gold Fever: Going along with Season 4's overarching theme of betraying that which you hold dear for something you desire, this ends up being his and Huff's undoing. I Will Punish Your Friend for Your Failure: Blackmails Reggie out of the club with knowledge of his affair with Little Paul's old lady, knowing it would result in her not receiving support from the club and Reggie getting brutally beaten if not worse.

characters.name: Lyla Dvorak-Winston
characters.description: A porn star employed by Luann Delaney. She and Opie begin to grow close from the time they meet. A single parent like Opie, she helps him with his children. Opie's involvement with Lyla is not entirely welcome by some, particularly Gemma and Tara, who initially are unable to look past Lyla's profession. Beauty Is Never Tarnished: Averted to an extent, on two separate occasions. Frankie Diamonds shot her in the leg while making his escape from the club and she spent the rest of the season recovering. In Season 6, after she was tortured, she received several small scars on her face and body. She's still gorgeous, even without makeup, but all the same, she's out of the porn star business. Everyone Loves Blondes: Opie certainly does. Hidden Depths: Has a head for business, and finds her calling post-porn helping Nero run Diosa Norte. Hooker with a Heart of Gold: Or rather, porn star with a heart of gold. Gemma and Tara have the nerve to judge her despite their own criminal behavior, but Lyla herself is a sweet young woman who loves Opie.

characters.name: Luann Delaney
characters.description: Gemma's best friend who runs a pornography studio, having received financial backing from Big Otto, her husband. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: After throwing a public tantrum over Jax's handling of Georgie Caruso, Jax's inviting her to an unused warehouse and surprising her in the dark reduces to her to blubbering and pleading for her life. Luckily, it turns out to be a business offer to partner with the Sons on a new porn studio. Dirty Coward: Has a tendency to throw noisy tantrums before quickly backing away when its made clear she can't intimidate a SAMCRO member. Forgotten Fallen Friend: Despite being a major business ally with the club and one of Gemma's closest friends, her death is quickly forgotten by all but Otto due to being unrelated to the greater ongoings of the club, and an attempt to find her killer would not really be made for several seasons. Ironically, the apathy by the club on this issue indirectly leads tothe death of Tara, Bobby, Gemma, and Jax.To wit; Bobby lies to Otto that the club avenged Luann's death. The AUSA Lincoln Potter uses this information to convince Otto to rat on the club, thus ensuring the RICO investigation can go through.The threat of RICO over the club's head leads Tara to volunteer at Stockton Penitentiary to try and convince Otto to recant his statement. He manipulates her into bringing a cross that belonged to Luann to him, which he uses to murder a nurse, thus invalidating his RICO testimony but implicating her as an accessory to murder.Tara then spends all of Season 6 trying to negotiate her way out of prison time while also attempting to leave Jax and the club behind. She finally makes up with Jax who agrees to take the fall for other unrelated crimes in exchange for Tara getting off the hook. Gemma, unaware of this and only informed that Jax is going to prison, confronts Tara in her home and murders her, then blames the Chinese Triad.This leads to the entirety of Season 7 where Jax's plan to free SAMCRO from the ruthless cr

characters.name: Mary Winston
characters.description: Piney's ex-wife and the mother of Opie.

characters.name: Donna Lerner-Winston
characters.description: Opie's wife and the mother of his two children. She doesn't trust SAMCRO after Opie serves extensive jail time for the club. Donna and Opie go through a difficult time in their marriage and come close to separating, but Donna has a change of heart after Opie is set up by ATF Agent June Stahl to appear to be an informant. Donna resolves her feelings and seems okay with Opie being a member of SAMCRO. Accidental Murder: Tig meant to kill Opie while he drove home, but Donna was driving the truck instead due to a last minute switch-up. Broken Bird: The Club ruined her family, and ultimately ended her life. For the rest of the series, her death is reflected on as what any one can expect their life to end when involved with the Club. Butt-Monkey: Donna constantly struggles with money, had to go years without her husband who was locked inside while raising two kids, and when he finally gets out of prison he quickly falls back into the outlaw lifestyle and Donna winds up dead. I Just Want to Be Normal: What she wanted for her family. Thank to the Club and Stahl, it didn't work out.

characters.name: Nate Madock
characters.description: Gemma's elderly father. He suffers from the early stages of dementia (believing his wife to still be alive) and has a caretaker. Ate His Gun: Subverted. He contemplated it during one of his lucid moments, but decided not to. My God, What Have I Done?: He has this reaction when he realizes he shot Tig, thinking he was raping his wife. Outliving One's Offspring: He ends up outliving his every relative except for his great-grandsons, although he's too ravaged by his Alzheimer's.

characters.name: Dawn and Fawn Trager
characters.description: The daughters of Tig and his ex-wife Colleen. Manipulative Bitch: Dawn thinks she is, squeezing money out of her father. Tig actually knows she's just trying to con him, but goes along with it so he can spend time with her. Morality Pet: Played straight in some ways in relation to Tig, but subverted in other ways since they both despise him for his lifestyle and neglectful parenting. Kill It with Fire: Damon Pope burns Dawn alive in revenge for his daughter's death. What the Hell, Hero?: Fawn gives one to Tig after Dawn's death.

characters.name: Precious Ryan
characters.description: The ex-wife of Bobby and current wife of Sergio Coletti. She has two kids by Bobby and one of their kid has a health problem. Bobby owes her a lot of money in child support and always claims "the check is in the mail". Happily Married: Certainly not to Bobby, but she's traded up to a happier marriage to her handsomer, bounty hunter husband Sergio.

characters.name: Abel Teller
characters.description: The son of Jax and Wendy. Age-Appropriate Angst: He is deeply affected by the loss of Tara, the only mother he's ever known and is shown acting out over the course of several episodes, constantly causing the otherwise very distracted adults to have to stop and focus on what he needs. Armor-Piercing Question: Abel overhears Gemma admitting to killing Tara but she claims it was all a terrible accident. Later, Abel intentionally hits a kid with a metal lunchbox, requiring stitches, but he claims it was an accident.Gemma:Do you know what an accident is?Abel:Doyou? Ax-Crazy: The kid is only five years old and already is a violent psycho. Such as when he smacks a kid with a metal lunchbox and using a hammer to protect his brother. Babies Make Everything Better: Not really. Jax and Wendy do make a cursory attempt to working out their relationship, but it comes to an end quickly and Wendy is shipped off to rehab. Gemma and Tara become Abel's main female caregivers.

characters.name: Thomas Teller
characters.description: The son of Jax and Tara. Children Are Innocent Dead Guy Junior: Named after Jax's younger brother who died of the same congenital heart defect that Gemma and Abel had.

characters.name: Charles "Chucky" Marstein
characters.description: A prison friend of Otto's who was a bookkeeper for a Triad gang. Chuck proved to be rather paranoid and also afflicted with compulsive masturbation disorder that reared itself at inopportune times. Chuck has all but his index fingers cut off when his compulsive masturbation disorder became too much for Henry Lin to tolerate. When Chuck's services were no longer needed, Lin offered to trade Chuck back to SAMCRO but Clay refused. Tig, feeling sympathetic, offered to take Chuck and promised to set him up as the new bookkeeper at Luann's studio. This turned out to be a good move as Chuck has proved himself to be a capable accomplice on numerous occasions. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: He might be a paranoid weirdo, but he's saved the Sons plenty of times whether it's providing a distraction, disposing of bodies in chili or providing two million dollars of counterfeit money. Butt-Monkey: Things rarely go right for him; he's targeted in prison and eventually has his fingers sliced off. Catchphrase: "I accept that." Cloud Cuckoo Lander: In Season 5. First he speaks in limericks and when Gemma orders him to cut it out he begins to reply stuff in French. In Season 6 he plays a kazoo and speaks with it.

characters.name: Ally Lowen
characters.description: A colleague of Rosen, and the new legal counsel of SAMCRO. Amoral Attorney: She jokingly refers to which 'innocent' needs defending the most: the murderous motorcycle club or the morally ambiguous doctor. Subverted in Season 6, in which she's helping Tara build a case to divorce from Jax and take the children away from Charming. Deadpan Snarker: "You do know I charge hourly, right?"

characters.name: Elliot Oswald
characters.description: A prominent businessman and ranch owner in Charming. Deal with the Devil: He makes these deals with the Sons on a regular basis. Nice Guy: Despite his dealings with the club, Elliot is a genuinely good person and loving father. Non-Idle Rich: He's one of the richest people in Charming, and actually does things to help his town. Papa Wolf: After his daughter is raped, his immediate reaction is to go to Clay for justice.

characters.name: Lowell Harland, Jr.
characters.description: A second-generation mechanic at Teller-Morrow and a drug addict. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: After returning from rehab seemingly sober, Lowell is never seen again, although he's still implicitly working for Teller-Morrow off-screen. Functional Addict: He's capable of doing his job, but not while completely whacked out of his gourd.

characters.name: Rosen
characters.description: Amoral Attorney: He works with the Sons despite knowing entirely about their dealings. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: After Season 2 and replaced with Ally Lowen. Hello, Attorney!: Male example.

characters.name: Lumpy Feldstein
characters.description: A local boxing club owner, a survivor of the Holocaust and a close friend of SAMCRO. Refusing to sell his clubhouse to an unknown buyer (revealed to the viewers to be Jacob Hale, Jr.) he finds himself and the clubhouse under increasing threats of violence. Cool Old Guy: Lumpy is pretty damn cool; he owns his own boxing club, is still involved in the training and is aRetired Badass. Odd Friendship: Had a tentative one with Darby, the leader of the local Neo-Nazi movement. Retired Badass: He has a host of boxing trophies, and isn't afraid of anyone.

characters.name: Neeta
characters.description: Abel's baby-sitter. Following Abel's kidnapping, she hasn't appeared on the show. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Doesn't appear once after the third season begins, not even to show up the next day and be told they don't need her.

characters.name: Lieutenant Eli Roosevelt
characters.description: A member of the San Joaquin County Sheriff's Department and the head of Charming's law enforcement following the dissolution of Charming Police Department. Prior to his assignment in Charming, he spent fifteen years in Oakland working as part of an anti-gang task force. He is a strict, no-nonsense officer, confronting the Sons of Anarchy upon their release from prison and stating that any cuts worn in public by members on parole would be confiscated. Beard of Sorrow: After Rita's and their unborn child's deaths. He shaves it for Season 6. The Determinator: When he starts something, he finishes it. Demoted to Dragon: To both Jacob Hale and then to U.S. Attorney Potter. He outgrows it. Demoted to Extra: By Season 6. Most of his screentime is spent being asked to leave a room.

characters.name: Sheriff Althea Jarry
characters.description: She is the Sheriff of the Charming Police Department during Season 7, and was appointed by Patterson before she left at the end of Season 6. It's established early that she has a thing for bikers, and she is undeceive about doing her job, despite pretending that she is in control. All Girls Want Bad Boys: Not long after her introduction, she starts a relationship withChibs. Analogy Backfire: When Unser and her visitJuicein prison to try and uncover more about Eli and Tara’s murder from him, she asks ifJuice“tired of being someone’s asshole” in reference to him being constantly manipulated by everyone on the show.Juice, who at this point is being raped daily, responds with “All I am in here is someone’s asshole.” Corrupt Cop: Like Unser, but not nearly as smart or clever and lacking any financial motivation to help the club. Meaningful Name: An obscure one. The famous line "Stone walls do not a prison make, nor iron bars a cage," is from the poem "To Althea, From Prison." Fitting for a sheriff.

characters.name: Deputy Chief David Hale
characters.description: The deputy chief of the Charming Police Department. Chief Unser nicknames him "Captain America" for his black and white views and squeaky clean image (prior to his involvement with L.O.A.N. and sexual encounter with an ATF agent), adherence to the law and, possibly, because of his square-jawed all-American looks. He is a native of Charming, California, who knew of SAMCRO while he was growing up and who delivered newspapers to the Teller household. His father is a county judge and a very powerful and wealthy man. David has an older brother, Jacob, Jr.. He is next in line for the job of chief once Wayne Unser retires. Unlike Unser, Hale wishes to purge the town of SAMCRO upon becoming police chief. By-the-Book Cop: Usually sticks to the rules, and doesn't engage in corruption or brutality. Dropped a Bridge on Him: Hale was with the show from the beginning, established very quickly as a nigh-unmovableHero Antagonist, both aWorthy Opponentto Jax as well as his opposing counterpart. However, he's killed very suddenly with almost zero build-up in a particularly anti-climatic way in the first episode of the third season: hit by a van. He's never discussed again. Fair Cop: Unser even calls him 'Captain America'. Friendly Enemy: Not all the time, but he can be courteous, friendly, and polite to the Sons.

characters.name: Deputy Sheriff Cane
characters.description: A Deputy Sheriff in the San Joaquin County Sheriff Department. He is based in the Charming-Morada Sub-Station under the command of Lieutenant Eli Roosevelt and partnered with Deputy Martinez. The Lancer: To Roosevelt.

characters.name: Officer Candy Eglee
characters.description: A member of the Charming Police Department. She is shown to be sympathetic towards SAMCRO and the Chief Wayne Unser. Bit Character: She often appears when Hale and Unser need to have other officers around them.

characters.name: Sheriff Victor "Vic" Trammel
characters.description: The local county sheriff and, in addition to being on the payroll of SAMCRO, he appears to have a great deal of insider information on their illicit activities. Bus Crash: Trammel dies of his injuries off-screen, and SAMCRO gets a call stating that he didn't make it. Dirty Cop: He's in SAMCRO's pocket. Mauve Shirt: He was a minor recurring character for a few episodes before being killed off in season 2. What the Hell, Hero?: To Jax, when he finds out the guns used to attack his prisoner escort and kill his friend came from the Sons.

characters.name: Agent June Stahl
characters.description: A corrupt ATF agent investigating the club's involvement in arms trafficking. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: She quickly resorts to weeping and crying for mercy when faced with danger. Ambition Is Evil: She only wants to bring down SAMCRO because of how it will look on her record. Her actions to do so get more corrupt and cold-blooded before she is finally killed by Opie. Asshole Victim: Herdeathat the hands of Opie, where shepathetically begs for mercy, was definitely a long-time coming. Berserk Button: When caught off-guard by a physical attack she often flies into a rage and can't think straight, and often makes the situation much more of a personal vendetta.

characters.name: Agent Joshua Kohn
characters.description: A Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives agent pretending to investigate SAMCRO. He and Dr. Tara Knowles dated in Chicago until he became threatening and she obtained a restraining order against him. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: He begs Tara to call an ambulance and not let him bleed out after she shoots him. Arch-Enemy: To Jax, who he sees as a rival for Tara. Asshole Victim: After refusing to leave her alone, he eventually tries to rape Tara. Fortunatelly, Jax arrives and kills him before that happens. Attempted Rape: He almost rapes Tara, but she manages to escape him at the last minute by shooting him in the gut.

characters.name: Agent Amy Tyler
characters.description: An ATF agent who was both June Stahl's professional and personal partner. Ambiguously Evil: Unlike Stahl, it's never fully revealed if Tyler was actually corrupt or if she was simply in love with someone who dragged her into a web of lies and deceit, which got her killed in the end. It's also possible that shewascorrupt, but grew wary of Stahl after seeing she was becoming too reckless and keeping too many secrets from her. Extreme Doormat: Stahl mistreats her is almost every scene they are in together, and she doesn't once standup for herself. Flat Character: She's Stahl's girlfriend and an ATF agent. By the time she starts growing suspicious of Stahl's dealings and begins to develop even a tiny bit, Stahl kills her. Frame-Up: Stahl kills her and then frames her for the murder of Edmond Hayes.

characters.name: Tyne Patterson
characters.description: The San Joaquin County District Attorney from Stockton assigned to aggressively address the violence plaguing Charming, specifically from a school shooting resulting in the deaths of four children using a gun acquired from the Sons of Anarchy motorcycle club. To do so, she works with former U.S. Marshal Lee Toric to investigate the Sons. She and Galen O'Shey serve as the main antagonists of Season 6. Anti-Hero: Goes to some extreme lengths to accomplish her goals, but never crosses theMoral Event Horizon. Back for the Finale:Unlike Barosky and Marks, she escapes with her life, though her reputation will undoubtedly take a hit in the process. Big Bad Ensemble: Of Season 6 alongside Galen O'Shay. Black Boss Lady: In her capacity as the San Joaquin County District Attorney.

characters.name: Assistant U.S. Attorney Lincoln "Linc" Potter
characters.description: An Assistant U.S. Attorney operating out of Charming. He headed a joint agency task force targeting the Sons of Anarchy's arms trafficking business under the Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act. He and Clay Morrow serve as the main antagonists of Season 4. Big Bad Ensemble: Initially set up as one alongside Clay Morrow in Season 4 before turning out to be asubversion. When first introduced, Potter appears to be aDirty Copsimilar to Stahl, working the Sons of Anarchy for his own ruthless ends. However, after the CIA ruins his RICO investigation, he reveals his true colors by thanking Roosevelt for his hard work, covering for Juice with SAMCRO, and undermining Hale's development project — not because any of this brings him anything, but because the CIA's interference has made things worse for Charming. He does what little he can to make them better as he goes. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: Prone to philosophize and even does ballet moves on top of the table when left alone in his Secret Room. And eat candy while Otto reads the deal to sell out the club. And smoking while hanging upside down. The Chessmaster: He's a master at making it utterly impossible for anyone to go against his wishes. Consummate Liar: He doesn't even need to lie as much as he does, it just seems to amuse him. Only Otto ever picks up on it.

characters.name: Agent Grad Nicholas
characters.description: An FBI Agent assigned to investigating the SAMCRO's arms trafficking business. He works closely with Assistant U.S. Attorney Lincoln Potter, often by his side during various points in the investigation. Hero Antagonist: Like his boss, Potter. The Lancer: To Lincoln Potter.

characters.name: Lee Toric
characters.description: A former U.S. Marshall who was forced into retirement for a variety of reasons including excessive use of force and racial profiling. After his sister is killed by Otto Delaney, he makes it his mission to take down the Sons of Anarchy. Anti-Villain: Seems poised to become type III or IV. Big Bad: For Season 6.Subvertedwith his death at Otto's hands in "Wolfsangel" just four episodes into the sixth season. Cowboy Cop: When he was a U.S. Marshal, now he's more of aRabid ExCop. Cultured Badass: At the end of "Darthy", he's seen reading "Watchfiends and Rack Screams" by French poet and theatre innovatorAntonin Artaud.

characters.name: Macky
characters.description: A corrupt prison guard loyal to the One-Niners. Asshole Victim: He is responsible forOpie's deathand ends up being killed by SAMCRO in a similar fashion. The Brute: A corrupt prison guard working for the One-Niners. Dirty Cop: Like Goodman, he works for Pope. Dirty Coward: When his wife shows up to defend him with a shotgun, he takes the chance to run away.

characters.name: Goodman
characters.description: A Detective in Oakland, under Damon Pope's employment. Bald of Evil: Goodman is bald and a more-than-willing employee of Damon Pope. The Brute: For Pope, within the law. He's later dismissed by Pope as being 'sloppy'. Dirty Cop: He's on Pope's payroll. Smug Snake: Goodman is much more confident than he has a right to be. It gets him killed.

characters.name: The Irish Kings
characters.description: The council of the True IRA in Belfast. First seen thanking SAMCRO for proving Jimmy O to have gone rogue, they later propose developing the relationship between the Sons and True IRA even further. According to Clay, they are the "Irish Kings, the Godfathers of the True IRA". Bald of Evil: Griffin is balding Boom, Headshot!:Roark in the series finale, courtesy of Jax. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Dooley after Season 4. Suspiciously Similar Substitute: Griffin to Dooley in Season 6.

characters.name: James "Jimmy O" O'Phelan
characters.description: The leader of the Real IRA group who sell guns to SAMCRO. Arch-Enemy: To Chibs. Jimmy is the one who gave him his scars, as well as stealing his family and exiling him from Ireland. Big Bad Ensemble: He shares the role ofBig Badduring Season 3 with Stahl, even though they're at odds. They provide serious problems for the Sons on separate fronts. Deadpan Snarker: Jimmy has some glib lines for bad situations. Upon being arrested and thus saved from death:"Thank goodness for the American justice system!" Dragon with an Agenda: to the True IRA Council

characters.name: Galen O'Shay
characters.description: A high-ranking member of the Real IRA directly involved in SAMCRO's affairs with the Galindo Cartel. Galen views Jax as impulsive and reckless following an incident stateside and holds him responsible for the death of Kellen Ashby. As such he is only willing to sell guns to Clay, necessitating Jax sparing Clay's life in order to maintain the deal with the IRA and the Cartel. He and Tyne Patterson serve as the main antagonists of Season 6. The AggressiveArms Dealer The Apprentice: He was one to Father Kellan. Badass Boast:"The Sons are gonna feel this on both continents." Badass in a Nice Suit: Always well-dressed.

characters.name: Connor Malone
characters.description: A member of the True IRA. Affably Evil: Juice considers him to be a 'decent guy' and going by all evidence, that's true. He's just working for a bad man. Beard of Evil: A goatee. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: He brought a piece of jewelry to bring back to a loved one, probably a young daughter. Mouth of Sauron: He relays Galen's wishes stateside.

characters.name: Father Kellan Ashby
characters.description: The consigliere of the Real IRA in Belfast. Kellan has a tendency to play God on some occasions despite the fact that he is as much a criminal as anyone else. Piney Winston states that while Ashby can't make any direct decisions for the True IRA, his input is highly valued. Affably Evil: Despite his utter ruthlessness, Ashby is a very pleasant man to speak to with a gentle, reassuring tone of voice. Anti-Villain: A mix of Type 3 and Type 1. Badass Preacher: Ashby is theonlyperson in the series so far to hand Jax a decisive beating (before Jax got a hold of a gun to even the playing field). The Consigliere: His official role in relation to the True IRA Council.

characters.name: Cameron Hayes
characters.description: McKeavey'scousin and also a member of the Real IRA. He becomes SAMCRO's new contact and gun runner afterMcKeavey'sdeath. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: Not in the actual moment of his death but the whole day he spends in Belfast before meeting his end is spent pleading to his higher-ups to pardon him. It doesn't work. Bald of Evil: Thinning, but still. Despair Event Horizon:Edmond's death utterly destroys Cameron, and quickly leads to his own death. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: While their relationship might be strained from time to time, Camerondoeslove his son Edmondand is distraught by his death.

characters.name: Edmond Hayes
characters.description: Cameron Hayes' son and business partner. Defensive Failure: Has a (presumably) loaded handgun and a federal agent caught dead to rights. What does he do? Half-heartedly point it at her as she approaches until she takes it away. Truly a hardened criminal. Jerkass: Cocky and condescending to the Sons. Star-Crossed Lovers: With Polly Zobelle.And just like Romeo and Juliet, they both die as a result of their own idiocy. Saying Too Much: Spills the beans that Jimmy O is coming stateside at the beginning of Season 2.

characters.name: Luke Moran
characters.description: Jimmy O's second in command in the USA. The Dragon: To Jimmy O, but only when he's in the United States. Fat Bastard: Lies to Jax's face about where his son is and pulls a gun on Chibs for threatening Jimmy O, after the latter threatened the former's family no less!

characters.name: Michael and Sean Casey
characters.description: Members of the Real IRA in Belfast, and very close to father Kellan - Maureen Ashby describes them as "being like sons to him". Boom, Headshot!:How they both die. Co-Dragons: For Father Kellan. Like a Son to Me: To Father Kellan, as mentioned by Maureen. Torture Technician: Sean. Just ask O'Neill.Unfortunately for Sean, unlike his brother he gets subjected to this by Jimmy O and Donny before getting executed.

characters.name: Donny
characters.description: Boom, Headshot!:Gets this from the Russians as he is nothing but dead weight once Victor makes the deal to hand Jimmy over to SAMCRO. The Dragon: For Jimmy O after Luke is handed over to Stahl by Jax. Undying Loyalty: To Jimmy O, who he sticks by even after Jimmy loses all his allies. Jimmy is dumbfounded by his subsequent disappearance.Doesn't seem like Donny had much choice in the matter.

characters.name: Ron Tully
characters.description: Karma Houdini: Tully is probably one of the most evil characters in the entire shows history. He brutally rapes and murders one of the most sympathetic characters left in the show. And what happens to him? Nothing. After killing Juice, he's never seen again and remains in his current powerful position. Knight Templar: Subverted. At first he comes across as a 'true believer', but Jax correctly deduces thatthe only color he's really interested in is green, which is borne out by the alliances he makes with several non-white gangs through the Sons. Maintaining the 'brand' just comes along with his position. Might as Well Not Be in Prison at All: He bought a visit room where he can discusses crimes and uses a cellphone. This means he is still a shot caller for outside operations. Prison Rape: He's a big fan, especially concerning Juice. Politically Incorrect Villain: It comes with being a high-ranking member of the Aryan Brotherhood. Whether he actually holds these views privately is up for debate, but he has no problem airing them out in public.

characters.name: Eddie Gerber
characters.description: Dragon Ascendant: He used to be in the Nordics, but when Darby left Gerber stepped up to form his own gang. Politically Incorrect Villain: What with being the leader of a white supremacist gang and all. Those Wacky Nazis: He's a Neo-Nazi. We Hardly Knew Ye: His appearance is rather brief before he's killed.

characters.name: Leland Gruen
characters.description: Asshole Victim:Hegoes to the hospital and tries to kill the policewoman that witnessed their failed drug deal, so he won't exactly be missed when Unser kills him. Evil Is Petty: He doesn’t want to hold in the same object previously held by "n*gger-lovers". Politically Incorrect Villain: Even by AB standards he is definitely one of the worst.

characters.name: Ernest Darby
characters.description: The head of the Nordics (also known as "Nords"), a white supremacist gang mainly involved in meth trafficking. Bald of Evil: Being in a white supremacist gang and all. Big Bad Wannabe: In the first two seasons. He likes to think he'll be the guy to run the Sons out of Charming. He's very much not. The Bus Came Back: In season 3 and season 6. Butt-Monkey: His goals rarely succeed, and he eventually gets beat down so much that he becomes something of a has-been.

characters.name: Ethan Zobelle
characters.description: The head of the League of American Nationalists ("L.O.A.N."), a white separatist gang who desires to gain a foothold in Charming and force SAMCRO out. Batman Gambit: This is his main weapon against rival gangs, especially the Sons. Big Bad: Zobelle rolls into Charming to become theBig Badof Season 2, instigating violence and going to war with SAMCRO. The Chessmaster: Plays SAMCRO several times in season 2. Consummate Liar: He's able to keep his good reputation with the general public thanks to being an excellent liar. Furthermore, deception, trickery, and subterfuge are his preferred tools and he uses them often and with nearly everyone he interacts with; he has true believer thugs like Weston do his dirty work and keeps them on his side by convincing them he's also a believer instead of using them for his own purposes, he gets a morally upright cop like Hale to at least consider him as a possible better option than SAMCRO by spinning a story where Zobelle is aWell-Intentioned Extremistfighting against the influence of corruption and criminality, etc.

characters.name: A.J. Weston
characters.description: The muscle, or street leader, of the League of American Nationalists (also known as "L.O.A.N."), a white separatist gang trying to gain control in Charming and force SAMCRO out. Weston is an extremely violent ex-convict who carries out the brutal attacks on SAMCRO orchestrated by the L.O.A.N. commander, Ethan Zobelle. Weston's direct and die-hard connection to the Aryan Brotherhood makes him dangerous, since he can provide manpower to his gang to sell weapons and drugs to the residents of Charming (SAMCRO disdains hard drugs and protects their town from drug dealers). Bald of Evil: He's a skinhead, after all. Card-Carrying Villain: He has a big tattoo on his chest saying "I kill niggers". Child Soldiers: Weston has basically turned his kids into little white supremacist soldiers for the race war he's so sure is coming. The Dragon: To Zobelle, but he is quick to turn on Zobelle when the Sons show him that Zobelle is a faker only using L.O.A.N and the white supremacist movement for Zobelle's own ends.

characters.name: Polly Zobelle
characters.description: The scheming daughter and accomplice of Ethan Zobelle. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: Looks and acts like a sweet lil' lady... who's willing to help knock out Gemma in order to be raped. Daddy's Little Villain: She's involved in her father's professions, including the illegal ones. Dark Action Girl: Willing to take a blackjack to Gemma's head in order to help her father's enterprise. The Dragon: Is an accomplice to her father's many crimes.

characters.name: Ule
characters.description: A member of the League of American Nationals (L.O.A.N.). He has an antagonistic and distrustful relationship with A.J. Weston, feeling that, as Zobelle's right-hand man, Weston's ardent white supremacist beliefs are not allowing L.O.A.N. to broaden their horizons. Bald of Evil: He's bald. He's in a white supremacist gang. The Brute: One of the League's larger members. Jerkass: Is just as irritable as Weston is. The Rival: To Weston, for the position of Zobelle's dragon.

characters.name: Romero "Romeo" Parada
characters.description: A high-ranking member of the Jose Galindo drug cartel, who has connections to Marcus Alvarez and the Mayans. Later revealed to be a CIA Agent. Affably Evil: For what it seems, he is genuinely polite and softspoken. Big Bad: Subverted. Nevertheless he'sThe Dragonto José Galindo, the head of the Cartel. Deus ex Machina/Diabolus ex Machina: At the last second, the revelation that he works for the CIA prevents the police from dismantling SAMCRO for good. However, his strong-arming forces Jax into continuing the gun deal and prevents him from killing Clay. Mole in Charge:Played With. He actually works for the CIA. But he is at the same time a high-ranking cartel member equally much. He is more of aCorrupt Copwho uses his position in CIA to strengthen his power.

characters.name: Luis Torres
characters.description: Romeo's second in command. The Dragon: To Romeo. Mole in Charge: He actually works for the CIA. Mouth of Sauron: He acts as Romeo's representative when he can't appear in person. Villainous Rescue: When the Russians capture Jax and Opie, Romeo, Luis and Rivera turn up and save them.

characters.name: Santo Rivera
characters.description: Villainous Rescue: When the Russians capture Jax and Opie, Romeo, Luis and Rivera turn up and save them.

characters.name: Marcus Álvarez
characters.description: The president of the Mayans Motorcycle Club, an Oakland-based rival motorcycle club that has allied itself with the white supremacist Nords in order to break SAMCRO's iron-fisted control over Charming. He and the Mayans are bitter rivals with the One-Niners gang, to whom SAMCRO supplies guns, thus resulting in an increasingly bitter rivalry with the Sons. Affably Evil: Whenever he is not having a beef with someone. Badass Biker: He's the Mayan president, which is not a position for wimps. Marcus shows little fear in desperate situations and is perfectly willing to stand on the front line with his troops. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: Subverted; he does love his son, but he loves his criminal empire much more. Even Evil Has Standards: He's against making deals with rats. He says this to Jax afterJuice tried bribing him with SAMCRO intel in exchange for safe passage to Mexico.Alvarez:Just for the record, even if we couldn't make a deal, I would've never made one with a rat.

characters.name: Esai Álvarez
characters.description: A member of the Mayans Motorcycle Club and the son of Marcus Álvarez. Too Dumb to Live: His father considers his attempted hits on Clay and Darby to be bad planning and sloppy work and is willing to send him to be killed by Happy. We Hardly Knew Ye: Killed off in his sole appearance in Season 1 to demonstrate Marcus’ ruthlessness and the high stakes of the outlaw lifestyle. "Well Done, Son" Guy: It's obvious he's eager to please his father.

characters.name: August Marks
characters.description: The current biggest crime boss and drug kingpin in Oakland, formerly Damon Pope's number two. Even more bloodthirsty than his former boss yet somehow more polite, he has no qualms doing what is necessary to get his point across. He worked for Pope since the age of 17, showing a long term affiliation to him and complete devotion, and took over Pope's position of power after his demise. Badass Boast:"Pope made his bones by being the smartest brother on the streets. I made mine by being the deadliest." Best Served Cold: A strong advocate of this. It's what Pope taught him, after all.Unfortunately for him and everyone else, Jax refuses to listen. Big Bad Ensemble: WithHenry Lin,Charles Barosky, and arguablyGemma Teller Morrowin Season 7. Black Irish: When meeting with Malone he boasts/jokes that his mother's maiden name wasMcDuffy.

characters.name: Damon Pope
characters.description: The most dangerous gangster in Oakland. A seemingly powerful businessman on the outside, Damon Pope is a ruthless and calculating crime lord who has power over many black gangs and does not hesitate to use extreme degrees of violence to demonstrate his power, and to make things go his way. He distances himself from his illegal activities, as he does not want any of them to leave a trail to him. He goes to extreme lengths to ensure exact order in his operations. Affably Evil: Despite being a ruthless crime lord, he is polite, personable and seems to genuinely take a liking to Jax and was looking forward to do business with him. Best Served Cold: After his daughter is killed he takes his time planning out his revenge. He researches his targets and makes sure that nothing that happens can be directly linked back to him. He isquite unhappywhen an underling's impatience forces him to start his plan early. He actually plans to keep Tig alive in prison and have him abused and tortured for years to come. Big Bad Ensemble: Of Season 5 with Clay Morrow. Boom, Headshot!: Via Tig.

characters.name: Laroy Wayne
characters.description: The leader of the One-Niners, being the primary contact for SAMCRO. A major player in gun-running and the heroin trade, SAMCRO supplied weaponry to the One-Niners while initially keeping the Mayans out of the loop. In a deal with SAMCRO, Laroy agreed to keep the Niners restricted to Oakland as long as their "business arrangements" were kept in tact, though retaliation and bad blood was not uncommon between Laroy and SAMCRO. Bald of Evil: He keeps his head shaved bald. Cruel and Unusual Death: August Marks implies that he dismembered Laroy while still alive, offscreen. "The little bitch was screaming so loud, I kinda lost my shit". Dropped a Bridge on Him: Laroy was first established as a major player in the very first episode, and was a recurring face since then. When his girlfriend Veronica Pope is killed by Tig, it looks like he has a revenge arc ready to be set up...but he's killed off between seasons and turns up only as a heap of body parts in the first episode of Season 5. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: Veronica Pope, his girlfriend.

characters.name: Tyler
characters.description: A member of the One-Niners. The Dragon: After Damon Pope's death and Marks' ascension, Tyler becomes this to Marks. Up until Marks begins to interfere with the Niners ability to retaliate against the Mayans, at least. Lovable Coward: At first, pre-taking a level in badass. He's understandably a stuttering mess when August kills Laroy, then Darnell and declares him to be the new man in charge. It's easy to sympathize with him, since he's suddenly been forced into a new role he doesn't want that puts him in massive amounts of danger. Number Two: To Darnell, and then to Marks, for a while. Smarter Than You Look: He might not have expected to take control of the Niners, or even particularly wanted the position, but he turns out to be pretty good at the job once he settles in.

characters.name: Riggs
characters.description: Number Two: To Tyler. We Hardly Knew Ye: Killed in his sole appearance.

characters.name: Darnell
characters.description: The short lived former leader of the One-Niners, killed by Damon Pope's assistant, August Marks, after being set up. Ineffectual Sympathetic Villain: Darnell has a tough time in his short appearance; his boss is killed, he's promote against his will and he's subsequently killed. Number Two: To Laroy, prior to his death. Red Shirt: He's killed by August to show that Pope isn't kidding around. Jax even lampshades it, who says that Darnell's murder is Pope sending the Sons a message thathedecides who lives or dies. Unwitting Pawn: To Pope and Marks, who set him up for death solely to prove a point.

characters.name: Carla
characters.description: Ax-Crazy: As revenge against Gemma for beating her, she holds Nero and Gemma at gunpoint and forces them to have sex right in front of her. When they refuse, she kills herself. Brother–Sister Incest: She's in love with Nero, her half-brother. Love Makes You Crazy: Her love for Nero and jealousy against Gemma. Mrs. Robinson: With Juice. Number Two: to Nero, her half-brother.

characters.name: Arcadio Nerona
characters.description: Ascended Extra: In Season 6, where he plays a major part in the school shooting arc. Boom, Headshot!:By Nero, no less. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: He dearly loves his girlfriend Darvany. Good Scars, Evil Scars: Has a gnarly one on his face. The Lancer: To Nero, who trusts him the most out of his gang.Until he chooses Darvany over the Byz Lats.

characters.name: Darvany Jennings
characters.description: All Girls Want Bad Boys: Arcadio's girlfriend. Murder Is the Best Solution: Jax resorts to this to keep her quiet. Vorpal Pillow: How Juice murders her.

characters.name: Renaldo
characters.description: Dragon Ascendant: Subverted. Renaldo doesn't really seem to have the brains for taking over the Byz Lats, given how he chooses to ambush his boss's business partners while they are trying to make a legitimate sale to him, then just goes about his business smoking weed and watching TV with his friends. It's hard to feel any pity for the guy when Nero guns him down in his own home. Smug Snake: Clearly has grown disdainful of Nero by the time we meet him to the point he insults Nero's disabled son.

characters.name: Fiasco
characters.description: Iconic Item: His black wooly ski hat. Number Two: After Arcadio's death. Tattooed Crook: He's a gang member involved with prostitution and other crimes, and he has his fair share of tattoos. You Are in Command Now: After Nero is imprisoned.In Season 7, Nero hands over leadership of the Byz Lats to him, even though he privately tells Jax that Fiasco’s ill-cautioned ambition will most likely be the undoing of the crew.

characters.name: Lupe
characters.description: Gangsta Style: He holds his gun this way. Tattooed Crook: He's a gang member involved with prostitution and other crimes, and he has his fair share of tattoos.

characters.name: Colette Jane
characters.description: The owner of an escort agency. Back for the Dead:She returns in Season 7, only to be killed off in the very same episode. Boom, Headshot!:She's killed in this way. Brutal Honesty: While Nero tries to be 'diplomatic', Colette has no problem calling a co-worker 'dumb as a rubber thumb'. Deadpan Snarker: She has a dry, subtle wit.

characters.name: Emma Jean
characters.description: Beauty Is Never Tarnished: She gets pretty badly beaten by Gemma, but is no worse for wear next time we see her. Farmer's Daughter: From Indiana, the trope is why she's so successful. Playing Against Type: As a prostitute involved with criminals and gangsters, Emma Jean is the opposite to the previous characters played by Ashley Tisdale.

characters.name: Erin Byrne
characters.description: Boom, Headshot!: Toric finishes her off this way after accidentally shooting her in the stomach. The Quiet One: According to Nero.

characters.name: Charlie Barosky (Stockton)
characters.description: A corrupt former police officer who still has ties with the local police agency and controls rackets around the Stockton ports. Affably Evil: Charlie's actually a pretty genial fellow. He's even politically correct, correcting Jax on the ethnicity of the torture porn directors.’’Persia hasn’t been a country since 637 A.D.’’ Boom, Headshot!:In the Finale, courtesy of Jax. Also counts as aDeath by Cameo. Cigar Chomper: He's usually seen with a cigar. Cool Old Guy: He's first seen smoking a cigar in the Italian bakery he owns, and from there on proves himself to be a reasonable and highly competent man.

characters.name: Viktor Putlova (The Russians)
characters.description: An old acquaintance of Jimmy O who handles the dealings of the Russian mob in California. Faux Affably Evil: He's usually smiling and jovial, quick to shake your hand and offer you a drink. This does little to hide the opportunistic and ruthless man he is. Horrible Judge of Character: Really, Viktor? Really? You thought that trusting Jax after you tried to murder him was wise? Karmic Death: Stabbed by Jax in retaliation for trying to have him killed in prison. The Mafiya: He seems to be the head of the Russian mob in California.

characters.name: Jimmy Cacuzza (Cacuzza crime family)
characters.description: The leader of a Mafia family and long-time associate of Clay. Affably Evil: He's a pretty genial guy to do business with. The Don: Of the Cacuzza crime family. The Mafia: He's the head of a crime family. Neighbourhood-Friendly Gangsters: To the Sons, particularly Clay.

characters.name: Leo Pirelli (Pirelli crime family)
characters.description: A mob boss based out of Lake Tahoe. Affably Evil: When the Sons start a fight in his club while looking for Frankie, he merely ponders how they get any business done if they get pissed off over every little dispute, and then allows Jax to say his piece. The Don: Of a Family operating in Lake Tahoe. Hair-Trigger Temper: Despite the above noted affability, he immediately guns down Frankie upon seeing that he killed one of Leo’s trusted men, screwing up Jax’s plan to prove Clay’s guilt.

characters.name: Henry Lin
characters.description: The Chinese-American leader of a San Francisco-based Triad.
