Acquitted Too Late:After Jax tries to beat Lin to death in the street with Barosky's intervention but is warded off byThe Cavalryin the form of non-corrupt cops, he spends the remainder of his vendetta trying to find a way to have Lin murdered in prison. This culiminates in Jax manipulating Juice's desire to earn his way back into the club into getting himself arrested in order to question Lin on the identity ofThe Ratwithin SAMCRO and then stabbing Lin to death while he hangs from a pipe. Unfortunately for both Juice and Lin, Jax discovers too late that the entire vendetta against the Triad was based on Juice and Gemma's lie and orders Juice's death in retaliation before shooting his own mother in the head. A Father to His Men: Out of all the criminals featured in the show, the only ones who can match Lin's level of loyalty to his associates are the Sons themselves. He isfuriouswhen his deal gets botched and he figures Jax as being the one responsible.His men go out of their way to attempt to kill Tully for orchestrating Lin's death and also rape Juice in revenge before attempting to force him to comply with said hit. Alas, Poor Villain:gets attacked by Jax and the Sons for something he didn’t do, gets the shit kicked out of him by Jax in front of his men, and then stabbed to death in prison by a rat after giving up information that was supposed to secure his life. Beard of Evil: Step up from Permastubble, and starting to grey.

characters.name: Bohai Lin
characters.description: The head of the Lin Triad and uncle to Henry Lin. Badass Boast:Jax:"Starting a war drains both sides."Bohai:"I am not starting it. I am joining it." Beard of Evil: Just like his nephew, but more prominent. Karmic Death: Bohai is killed by Happy after taking him hostage to force the Sons to hand over their gun business. Revenge Before Reason: He's willing to join a gang war to avenge Henry's injury at Galen's hands.

characters.name: Amir
characters.description: An Iranian criminal and pornographer. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: Despite being a filthy bastard who abuses and rapes women, Amir clearly cares about his brother Kia and starts on a campaign of revenge when he believes he has been killed. He also was clearly distraught when Barofsky killed one of his men. Roaring Rampage of Revenge: Against the Sons, after his brother disappears. Amir correctly assumes the Sons killed them, although Tig was acting alone.

characters.name: Kia
characters.description: An Iranian criminal and pornographer. Bullying a Dragon: Oh boy, it's not a good idea to taunt Tig by telling him you might enjoy raping his own daughter. Burial at Sea: Tig dumps his body inside a cage to make it sink. Iconic Item: His red jacket. Never Found the Body: His brother is unable to find his body, since Tig shoved him in a cage and dropped him in the water.

characters.name: TO Cross (Grim Bastards)
characters.description: The president of the Grim Bastards Motorcycle Club. He is a good friend of Clay Morrow and SAMCRO. Aborted Arc: Seems to be set up for a conflict with Jax and the Sons after theykill his cousin in retaliation for Opie’s murder. This is dropped by the Season 7 premier, with the Sons helping the Bastards track down a gang member who ran down three of their members in order to mend fences between the two clubs. Do Not Call Me "Paul": He hates it when he's referred by his first name, being Taddarius. Embarrassing First NameANDEmbarrassing Middle Name:Taddarius Orwell. Apparently he only allows his mother to refer to him as such. Neighbourhood-Friendly Gangsters: To the Sons, being their African-American counterparts essentially.

characters.name: Randall Hightower
characters.description: An inmate of San Joaquin County Correctional Facility and cousin to TO. Bald of Evil: He's completely bald. Beard of Evil: Randall has a very thick beard, and coupled with his bald head and massive height, it gives him a very distinctive appearance. Boom, Headshot!:Chibs kills him with a silenced pistol shot to the back of the head. Fat Bastard: A big guy who likes beating people.

characters.name: Dante (The Triple-Two)
characters.description: Laser-Guided Karma: While trying to flee, he's attacked by a dog...fitting considering he ran dog fights. Obviously Evil: Runs clandestine dog fights.

characters.name: Nate Meineke
characters.description: The leader of a local state Militia and terrorist group. He served in Vietnam alongside Piney. Affably Evil: Nate is a pleasant, somewhat meek guy whose authority is overridden by his more hot-headed son. Crazy Survivalist: Piney considers his group to be just some "survivalist cats playing capture-the-flag." Unfortunately, they turn out to be more of a dangerous liability due to their brazen criminal exploits with SAMCRO firearms. Evil Former Friend: To Piney, whose life he saved in Vietnam. Evil Old Folks: Being around Piney's age and is part of a prison breakout that gets innocent people killed.

characters.name: Russell Meineke
characters.description: Crazy Survivalist: One of the more paranoid and grouchy members of the militia. Jerkass: He's a basic asshole, aggressive and stand-offish. Number Two: To his Dad. Right-Wing Militia Fanatic: He's a member of a militia, like his father. Unwitting Instigator of Doom: His militia's rescue of a jailed member is what brings Agent June Stahl into play.Therestishistory.

characters.name: Jacob Hale Jr.
characters.description: A businessman and older brother of Deputy Chief David Hale. He becomes Mayor of Charming and is planning a new set of luxury homes known Charming Heights. Beard of Evil: In Season 5, he sports a nifty Van Dyke, because he wasn't enough like the devil. Blackmail: He's been on both sides of it. The Chessmaster: In Season 3, as he moves players across the board to earn himself the position of Mayor and make Charming Heights a reality. He succeeds in becoming Mayor. Corrupt Corporate Executive: A real estate executive willing to resort to pay criminals to vandalize places so that they are forced to sell to him.

characters.name: Ima Tite
characters.description: A porn star employed by Luann Delaney. At one point, she is infatuated with Jax and tries to make him and Tara break up. Later tries to do the same with Opie and Lyla(her supposed friend). All Girls Want Bad Boys: She has a 'thing' for bikers. Alpha Bitch: She's a gorgeous porn star, but underneath that appearance is a spiteful monster who goes out of her way to be a home wrecker. Asshole Victim: You know what they say about you should never hit a woman? Well, that rule doesn’t apply when it comes to Ima. Right, Jax? Even Evil Has Standards: She's more self-interested than truly evil, but still, she shows concern for Lyla when she's abused by Iranian pornographers.

characters.name: Hector Salazar
characters.description: The former president of the Lodi chapter of the Calaveras Motorcycle Club, a low-ranking club that does dirty work for the Mayans. Ax-Crazy: It's obvious the guy is out for blood all the time. Beard of Evil: Quite a snazzy one to boot. Blackmail: He blackmails Jacob Hale. Butt-Monkey: Nothing ever goes right for him.

characters.name: Georgie Caruso
characters.description: A rival to Luann Delaney in the pornography business, Caruso took advantage of Luann's legal troubles to steal away her performers, whom he physically abused and threatened to keep them from leaving. Cut Himself Shaving: He meets his end by being stuffed into the trunk of his car and shot several times. Somehow, this is ruled a suicide. Chronic Backstabbing Disorder: He has a nasty habit of double-crossing everyone he makes a deal with. Dirty Coward: His reaction to trouble is usually to run in the opposite direction, even at the expense of his allies. Exact Words: Georgie gets Bobby to promise not to kill him, but he doesn't think to get such a promise out of Tig and Opie.

characters.name: Brenan Hefner
characters.description: The Oakland Port Commissioner. He was described as being "very dirty" by Agent June Stahl, a "greedy prick" by Clay, a "piece of shit" by Chibs, an "asshole" by Piney, and was seen to be a frequent womanizer. Corrupt Politician: The Irish pay him to look the other way when bringing their guns into Charming via cargo ship. Fat Bastard: AportlyPort Commissioner that engages in crime and gets greedier with time. Greed: Wants the Irish to triple his payoff money. When they refuse, MichaelMc Keavyis killed for his trouble. SAMCRO decides to deal with him as they sawMc Keavyas a friend as well as owing it to the Irish for their long association and friendship. Offstage Villainy: Responsible for the death of MichaelMc Keavy.

characters.name: Venus Van Damme
characters.description: A transgender prostitute born Vincent Noone. Abusive Parents: Her mother used Venus (then Vincent) in child pornography, and continues to be a child pornographer who wants to introduce Venus' own son into the 'business'. Thankfully, this doesn't happen. Big, Screwed-Up Family: She comes from one. Broken Bird: She's led a life of terrible sexual and psychological abuse at the hands of her vile mother. The Cameo: ForWalton Goggins, one of the many old cast members fromThe Shield.

characters.name: Warren
characters.description: A con man who seduces Gemma. Asshole Victim: Becomes a victim of both assault and theft by Jax and Nero. But considering that he regularly seduces women and steals their stuff he definitely has it coming. Con Man: He regularly seduces women, including Gemma, so he can rob them. Laser-Guided Karma: See above.

characters.name: Alice Noone
characters.description: The abusive mother of Venus Van Damme. Abusive Parent: To Venus when she was Vincent. Asshole Victim: She was a horrendously abusive woman and a child porn director to boot. Nobody, not even Venus, mourns her when Jax blows her brains out. Boom, Headshot!: Courtesy of Jax, and boy, did she have it coming. Cure Your Gays: Attempted this on her child Venus (then Vincent) by having sex with him. It only gives Venus severe emotional scars.

characters.name: Red
characters.description: One of Alice's colleagues/lovers. Bald of Evil: He's a child pornographer, yeah, he's evil. The Dragon: For Alice. Fat Bastard: A tubby guy with a black heart. Evil Old Folks: Roughly the same age as Alice.

characters.name: Bachman
characters.description: An independent biker and "cleaner" who disposes of unwanted corpses. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: He's highly competent, but also very quirky, insisting on having a certain type of music played.Lest not forget, even TIG finds him eccentric and creepy but nonetheless regards him as very good at what he does. Lest not forget, even TIG finds him eccentric and creepy but nonetheless regards him as very good at what he does. The Cameo: For Stephen King, a self-proclaimed fan of the show. Clean Up Crew: Bachman is seemingly the go-to guy when the club needs to dispose of a sudden, unwanted corpse. He works alone, doesn't bring any tools he lists what will be needed and tasks his client to get them and he can make a whole body disappear without moving it from the house.

characters.name: Greensleeves
characters.description: Jerkass: Is a complete smugStraw Misogynistwith attitude problems. Kick the Dog: His first scene involves him abusing his prostitute Winsome. Kosher Nostra: Being a Jewish pimp. Smug Snake: Keeps threatening Jax even though he is defeated. Tattooed Crook: Is very inked despite it being against the rules of his religion.
